subject.title: Add CUA as a delegated-run provider

question: Should Crabbox accept CUA as a built-in delegated-run provider now, gated on live CUA lifecycle proof in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/678?
rationale: The issue asks for a new first-class provider plus config and credential-handling surface, and VISION.md requires real remote-provider lifecycle proof before merge; automation should not decide that product/security boundary alone.

options.title: Keep Paired With PR 678
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/678 as the implementation candidate once it has live proof, resolves conflicts, and maintainers accept the provider direction.

options.title: Defer Built-In CUA
options.body: Leave the issue open but pause the PR until CUA access, API stability, or provider scope is clearer.

options.title: Reject Core Provider For Now
options.body: Close the implementation path only if maintainers decide CUA should not be a built-in Crabbox provider at this time.

recommendation.title: Keep Paired With PR 678
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/678 as the implementation candidate once it has live proof, resolves conflicts, and maintainers accept the provider direction.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to provider framework docs, credential hardening, exact-claim cleanup, and the latest CUA lifecycle hardening commit on the linked candidate branch.
